Discover in ‘The Holy Spirit and You’ the key to the successful life you’ve always desired.
Get to know the One who answers to the Name of Jesus. Learn to walk with Him, and let Him lead you into your inheritance and your destiny in God.
‘The Holy Spirit and You’ will arouse in you a deep desire for an intimate relationship with the Holy Spirit and help you develop such a relationship.
THEN YOU AND THE HOLY SPIRIT CAN MAKE AN UNBEATABLE TEAM THAT WILL IMPACT YOUR WORLD!
